title: GitLab Duo agent processes configuration from a user-controlled source
summary: In affected GitLab Enterprise Edition releases the Duo agent processes configuration from a user-controlled source, allowing an authenticated user with Developer-role permissions to cause arbitrary command execution in a CI environment.

fixedBy.mitigation: Upgrade GitLab EE past 19.1.7, 19.2.5, or 19.3.1 on the corresponding release line
